name: FinalRun
description: Mobile app testing agent that runs YAML-described tests on Android and iOS with your own model key, with skills for coding agents.
whatItDoes: Generates, runs and repairs end-to-end tests for mobile apps. Developers either call the CLI themselves or let a coding assistant use the bundled skills to write tests for a feature and fix failures.
howItWorks: Tests and suites are YAML files of plain-language steps. The CLI launches the app on a device and a vision-capable model works through each step, with the model chosen by a flag. The user's own provider key is read from an env file. The documented install script is served from a different GitHub owner path than the repo's current name.

requirements.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
requirements.description: Provider key shown in the README; bring your own key

requirements.name: Android or iOS device or emulator

models: Google Gemini and other providers via own key
